title: HoloApes
tagline: Flex by truly diamond handing your Ape. Show CT who's got their Ape on ice.
description:
Flex by truly diamond handing your Ape and forever immortalizing it in a unique gem. Holoapes is a way for Ape owners to mint a truly unique derivative piece of digital art. 
Your HoloApe gem can now be used as a precious rock in your favorite composable metaverse ring, choker, bracelet or watch. 

Let CT know who's got their avatar on ice.
how_its_made: This project uses ScaffoldETH for minting. IPFS for storing your new rocks and jewelry. Both technologies make it super easy to spin up, start working on the smart contracts and test our prototype. ScaffoldETH provides an existing UI so we worked with bootstrap.js to 'steal' apes and then used the wrap function to mint the HoloApes.
